# telnyx_storage_migration_source (Resource)

A bucket in another cloud that storage migrations copy from, with the credentials to read it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Bucket name to migrate the data from.
- `provider_auth` (Attributes, Sensitive) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provider_auth))
- `source_provider` (String) Cloud provider from which to migrate data. Use 'telnyx' if you want to migrate data from one Telnyx bucket to another. One of `aws`, `telnyx`.

### Optional

- `source_region` (String) For intra-Telnyx buckets migration, specify the source bucket region in this field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the data migration source.

<a id="nestedatt--provider_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `provider_auth`

Optional:

- `access_key` (String) AWS Access Key. For Telnyx-to-Telnyx migrations, use your Telnyx API key here.
- `secret_access_key` (String) AWS Secret Access Key. For Telnyx-to-Telnyx migrations, use your Telnyx API key here as well.
